title: Attestation
description: Formal spec REQ-7-9. A create's `attestation`: a Data Integrity proof as in REQ-5-11, except `cryptosuite` may be any string (a resolver that does not implement it reports the attestation as unsupported, REQ-11-2) and `verificationMethod` is `did:guardian:<domain>?versionId=<version>#key-<n>` naming a key of the root identity's log, not a did:key reference.

proofValue.description: Multibase base58btc ('z'-prefixed) encoding of the raw, low-S signature bytes (REQ-5-13).
